query_plan.query: Which aircraft has the highest maximum passenger capacity?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by aircraft, select the one with the highest maximum passenger capacity.
steps.query: Return all aircraft together with the maximum passenger capacity, with their aircraft id and aircraft name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT aircraft.name FROM aircraft WHERE aircraft.max_passengers = ( SELECT MAX(max_passengers) FROM aircraft )

s1.sql_query: SELECT aircraft.aircraft, aircraft.max_passengers, aircraft.name FROM aircraft
